image_description: A close-up of a brass-cased marine-style barometer and thermometer combination instrument. The top section features a circular dial with a glass cover, displaying atmospheric pressure readings with a black pointer hand and numerical scale. The bottom section is a cylindrical brass housing containing a secondary dial (likely a thermometer) with weather condition icons (sun, clouds, rain). The casing has decorative rivets along the flange.

artifact_observations.location: Top dial face and bottom dial face
artifact_observations.reasoning: The numerical scales and labels on both dials are rendered as nonsensical blobs or distorted characters instead of legible numbers. This is a common AI failure mode for instruments requiring precise typography.

The reflections on the brass are slightly overly smooth and plastic-like in some areas, lacking the micro-scratches expected on real metal. Some rivets appear slightly fused into the flange rather than distinct raised elements.
The center pivot of the pointer hand appears slightly muddy and lacks a distinct mechanical pin or screw head, blending slightly into the dial background.
